en.html:
Retreating Soldier A"Prepare to withdraw...?"
Retreating Soldier B"Haan. Get ready, they said."
Retreating Soldier A"But Fudaraku hasn't fallen yet, no?"
Retreating Soldier B"As far as I know, no."
Retreating Soldier A"Then why are we withdrawing, yaar?"
Retreating Soldier B"That information has not reached my brain."
Retreating Soldier A"..."
Retreating Soldier B"Chal. If it's ending, that's good enough, no?"
Retreating Soldier A"...Haan. If it's ending, good enough."

ja.html:
撤退兵Ａ「撤退の準備……？」
撤退兵Ｂ「ああ。 　しとけってさ」
撤退兵Ａ「まだ普陀楽は陥としてないんだろ？」
撤退兵Ｂ「そのはずだ」
撤退兵Ａ「なのになんで、撤退なんだ？」
撤退兵Ｂ「わからん」
撤退兵Ａ「…………」
撤退兵Ｂ「まあ、終わるなら、いいだろ」
撤退兵Ａ「……そうだな。 　まあ、終わるなら、いいか」
